lines.lyric_translation: Sorry that I like you, I’m sorry
I’m sorry for liking you
Sorry that I like you, I’m sorry
If liking you is wrong
Sorry that I like you so much, I’m sorry

lines.lyric: Ti an naeryeo noryeokhaedo da tiga naseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 티 안 내려 노력해도 다 티가 나서
lines.lyric_translation: I tried to hide my feelings, but I guess it was too obvious
I’m sorry, I’m sorry
That I like you

lines.lyric: Na chamda chamda idaeroneun an dwel geot gata
lines.lyric_hangul: 나 참다 참다 이대로는 안 될 것 같아
lines.lyric_translation: I can’t, I can’t hide my feelings for you anymore

lines.lyric: Yonggireul nae han georeum deo dagaganda
lines.lyric_hangul: 용기를 내 한 걸음 더 다가간다
lines.lyric_translation: I bravely take a step closer to you
But this step was never easy

lines.lyric: Maeummeogeun huro deo oraen shigani geollyeotji
lines.lyric_hangul: 마음먹은 후로 더 오랜 시간이 걸렸지
lines.lyric_translation: I made up my mind long ago, but I still needed more time
But maybe I took too long

lines.lyric: Taimingi an maja naege bulttong twieonna
lines.lyric_hangul: 타이밍이 안 맞아 내게 불똥 튀었나
lines.lyric_translation: Our timings were off, I feel like I’m being punished

lines.lyric: Gakkaweojigi wihan ge deoneun dagagaji mothal
lines.lyric_hangul: 가까워지기 위한 게 더는 다가가지 못할
lines.lyric_translation: What I did to get closer to you was rather

lines.lyric: Byeogeul ssaha beoryeottaneun ge neomu eoieoptta
lines.lyric_hangul: 벽을 쌓아 버렸다는 게 너무 어이없다
lines.lyric_translation: Building a wall between us, I’m speechless
I blame myself, I blame you

lines.lyric: Nugul tathaeya halji molla weonmangman neureotta
lines.lyric_hangul: 누굴 탓해야 할지 몰라 원망만 늘었다
lines.lyric_translation: I don’t know whom to blame, my resent grows

lines.lyric: Geu byeogeul heomullyeoda nae maeumman muneojyeo
lines.lyric_hangul: 그 벽을 허물려다 내 마음만 무너져
lines.lyric_translation: Trying to break down the wall between us just breaks my heart

lines.lyric: Geu mam dajabeuryeoda jeil jungyohan neol nochyeo
lines.lyric_hangul: 그 맘 다잡으려다 제일 중요한 널 놓쳐
lines.lyric_translation: While making my mind up, I missed the most important one, you
When I gave you a movie ticket, you were just so happy

lines.lyric: Ijen nado moreuge budamkkaji deohae jweo
lines.lyric_hangul: 이젠 나도 모르게 부담까지 더해 줘
lines.lyric_translation: But now I’m unintentionally pressuring you
I just wanted to be with you, the two of us, together
The tickets were just an excuse
To be just friends / You’re too beautiful
To just stay as friends
I know I’ll regret, so I end this
I know I’ll regret, so I decide to express my feelings
I want to be more than just friends
I like you too much
Sorry that I like you, I’m sorry
I’m sorry for liking you
Sorry that I like you, I’m sorry
If liking you is wrong
Sorry that I like you so much, I’m sorry

lines.lyric_hangul: 티 안 내려 노력해도 다 티가 나서
lines.lyric_translation: I tried to hide my feelings, but I guess it was too obvious
I’m sorry, I’m sorry
That I like you

lines.lyric: Mal an deunneun i gamjeongeul sumgida
lines.lyric_hangul: 말 안 듣는 이 감정을 숨기다
lines.lyric_translation: I try to hide this feeling that I can’t control

lines.lyric: Mal an deunneun i gamjeonge ikkeullinda
lines.lyric_hangul: 말 안 듣는 이 감정에 이끌린다
lines.lyric_translation: I get carried away by this feeling that I can’t control

lines.lyric: Neon tto maldo an dweneun maeryeogeul heullinda
lines.lyric_hangul: 넌 또 말도 안 되는 매력을 흘린다
lines.lyric_translation: With you being so irresistibly charming

lines.lyric_hangul: 한눈팔 걸 괜히 봐서 또 홀린다
lines.lyric_translation: I should have looked away / Yet I’m mesmerized again
The time waiting for you
Feels like waiting for a traffic signal at a four way street
The fact that we’ve grown even further apart than we were / Makes me weary

lines.lyric_hangul: 괜히 솔직해서 후련함은 없고 후회만 길다
lines.lyric_translation: Because of my honesty, there is no relief / All that remains is regret
To be just friends / You’re too beautiful
To just stay as friends
I know I’ll regret, so I end this
I know I’ll regret, so I decide to express my feelings
